title: Affine Artin--Rees stabilization of coherent formal kernel images
statement:
theorem coherentFormalModule_kernel_affine_bound {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F H : CoherentFormalModule X I) (α : F ⟶ H)
    (U : X.affineOpens) :
    ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ (l m : ℕ) (h : m + c ≤ l) (W : X.Opens), W ≤ U.1 →
      Set.range ((Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op l)) ≫
        F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right m c) h)).op)).app W) =
      Set.range ((Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫
        F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op)).app W)

source.place: Lemma 087X, proof of claim (a): affine localization and Artin--Rees calculation

proof.text: Use the finite-level affine comparison to obtain completed modules M,N and map f. Noetherianity of the completion permits applying the proved algebraic Artin--Rees kernel-image bound.

For l >= m+c, both quotient submodules (at l and at m+c) equal the image of ker(f) modulo J^(m+1)M by the algebraic bound. Transitivity gives equality; the forward implication of the affine comparison gives equality of section ranges on every W inside U.
